### Professionally

I love data and research. I lean more toward the analytics and decision science parts of data science. R is my preferred programming language, although I'm always interested in learning new skills (and have taught myself Python). I have been a freelancer in various areas of data, statistics, research — in doing, consulting, and teaching - for over a decade.

My educational background is a PhD in social psychology with a quantitative methods concentration from New York University, where I conducted both experimental and cross-sectional/survey research. I previously earned a psychology BA from Northwestern University.

See my [Resume](./resume.qmd) for more details.


### Personally

Outside of work, I enjoy surfing, food and cooking, reading (news, non-fiction, and fiction), learning, health and wellness, and traveling.
